question: Can I use Visual AI for free?
answer:
Yes. Every new account gets 30 persistent credits that never expire, plus 30 daily credits that reset every day at 00:00 UTC (unused daily credits do not roll over). You can generate, upscale, colorize, restore, and remove backgrounds with those credits — no card and no subscription required to start.

When you need more, buy credit packs on the pricing page. Purchased credits persist and never expire. Visual AI Pro is an optional plan for a higher daily allowance and premium models.

question: How quickly can I generate images?
answer: Generation time depends on the model and settings you choose. Higher-resolution or premium models can take longer than everyday models. Visual AI is a still-image studio (no video). We keep the pipeline as fast as we reasonably can for every account.

question: How do credits work?
answer: Each generation or edit spends credits. You get 30 persistent credits that stay on the account, plus 30 daily credits that reset every day at 00:00 UTC, unused ones included. Purchased credits never expire.

question: Which models can I use?
answer: Still-image models from Google, OpenAI, xAI, ByteDance, and Black Forest Labs, plus upscalers and utilities like colorize, restore, and background removal. See per-model costs on /pricing#model-costs.

question: Do I need a subscription?
answer: No. You can use Visual AI on credits alone. Visual AI Pro is an optional subscription with a higher daily allowance, premium models, and private generations.
